# Small business income tax offset
## Eligibility
The small business must have an aggregated turnover of less than $5 million for the 2016–17 income year onwards.

| Income year | Aggregated turnover threshold | Rate of offset | Maximum offset |
|-|-|-|-|
| 2021–22 and onwards | $5m | 16% | $1,000 |
